item.title: Arab States Scramble to Adapt to New Regional War
item.description: Since the United States and Israel began intensive airstrikes against Iran on Feb. 28, Iran has retaliated with missile and drone strikes against multiple Arab countries. Although Iran says it is striking U.S. military targets based in the Arab states, it has also hit civilian infrastructure and buildings. item.title: Gaza and the Logic of High-Intensity Urban Warfare
item.description: To analyze a war accurately, one must apply an analytical framework suited to its actual character.
